question: Does review distinguish actual implementation responsibility from unchanged documented responsibility when validation moves across the syscall/timekeeper boundary?
scope: One developer-exposed, researcher-modified counterfactual; behavioral diagnostic only, not document benefit, real violation detection, architectural optimality or reconstruction of a historical bug
intervention: Move the private Timekeeper range validation to the syscall helper after its authorization check; keep owner state update, locked fresh sample and notification path. Retain original comments as potentially stale evidence. Only archived copies may change.
confounds: Validation location and monotonic sampling relationship both change
Other direct timekeeper callers lose private validation
Original documentation may no longer describe candidate implementation
Private upper-bound formula is duplicated in the syscall helper
No full build or runtime reachability proof
admission: Two-file actual diff reconstructs from archived originals
Range expression and failure mapping are accounted for
Reviewer audits actual patch, not intended change
No runtime bug or production violation oracle inferred

conditional_execution.gate: Independent candidate review permits a source-grounding diagnostic; otherwise close without model responses
conditional_execution.agents: Fresh non-forked reviewers, one original and one candidate, no follow-up or correction
conditional_execution.common_inputs: Same seven source/document paths, same neutral task, same file boundaries and ordinary comments
conditional_execution.limits: Instructions prohibit tools; not an enforced sandbox. Agent identity and packet hashes recorded before dispatch. No equal-compute claim.

evaluation.source_grounding: Does each central behavior claim match the supplied function bodies rather than merely comments?
evaluation.responsibility: Does review distinguish authorization, range validation, state update and delegation?
evaluation.condition_preservation: Does it avoid treating NULL no-op as a required authorization path?
evaluation.change_obligation: Candidate reasoning must not repeat the original same-lock validation claim without qualifying the actual code conflict
evaluation.uncertainty: Does it separate static structure from executed race, compile success or globally proven safety?
evaluation.reporting: Per-claim evidence and unsupported claims; no weighted score or general detection accuracy

stop: One candidate admission and at most two responses. No variants, prompt tuning, retry seeds, concurrency harness or production fixes. Preserve rejection and failed controls.
